entities.name: Kitt Kanto
entities.description: Leonin Cabaretti crooner and best singer in New Capenna, once a subway busker in the Caldaia.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: Cabaretti leader who noticed Kitt and offered her a job.

events.summary: Jetmir notices Kitt busking in the Caldaia and offers her a job.
events.quote: until she was noticed by Jetmir and offered a job

events.summary: Kitt becomes the family's premier act and headlines the Cabaretti's main club.
events.quote: she became the family's premier act

relations.quote: Kitt Kanto is a leonin woman and Cabaretti crooner in New Capenna .

relations.note: Jetmir discovered Kitt and hired her.
relations.quote: until she was noticed by Jetmir and offered a job
